title: Result of report.list: the compact reports a keeping standing instruction kept
description: Request args: {"after"?, "limit"? (1 to 8, default 8)}. The reports the device holds above `after` (default 0), oldest first, as the exact signed bytes they were sent with. A page stops where the result would not fit the link, and continues after its last cursor. A report with `location` goes only to a caller allowed to read it; for any other it is left out whole and counted in `withheld`. A read takes nothing.

cursor.description: A counter that only grows, never reused, also across a reboot.

boot.description: The boot number inside the signed report.

seq.description: The sequence number inside the signed report.

report.description: The report as it was sent, signature included, in base64.

more.description: Another report the caller may read is held above the last one listed.

dropped.description: Reports pushed out of the full ring, or that could not be written, since the last report.ack.

withheld.description: Reports above `after` left out because they carry location and the caller may not read it.
